title: The Sunken Road
text: An old road runs sunk between high banks, shaded by trees and quiet. There are no birds. It is a perfect place for an ambush, as everyone knows. On the banks above, the bracken stirs, though there is no wind.

options.label: The quickest scouts the banks first to learn what stirs the bracken.

outcomes.text: Bandits are napping there. They wake up surrounded.

options.label: Go through fast with shields up, trusting speed over caution.

outcomes.text: There is nothing there after all but the bracken, stirring.
There is something there after all.

options.label: Go over the banks the hard way, leaving the road to whoever waits on it.

outcomes.text: It is all brambles and mud, but there is no ambush.
